scope: Fresh profile; registry/preferences readiness; windowed/light/200%/narrow; flow bottom only
unchanged: revealVectorEdge only gains in-memory steps registration; original 30-wheel/160ms budget and geometry/hit assertions unchanged
Actual XTest input, no DOM scroll or synthetic event writes
Data full-file-byte/version/dirty checks retained around scope

observation.geometry: Existing vectorGeometry execute adds monotonic time and previewNodeId; each result including assertion-failing geometry retained in memory
observation.events: Capture scroll only for editor or current/previous target preview; childList observer only target content with target-related filtering; latest256 events with dropped count
observation.flush: No per-wheel writes. catch writes windowed-scroll-observation-failure.json before failure screenshot; finally writes windowed-scroll-observation.json separately so the failure-time event window is preserved.

limitations: Fresh direct-to-windowed scope does not recreate preceding ordinary/theme history
Observations may perturb timing; not a root-cause conclusion
DOM presence and geometry alone do not prove painted pixels; screenshots retained
When the WebView cannot respond, Node-side collected steps still written and browserReadError recorded
